name: The Four Seasons
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly established the four seasons as part of His creation, setting lights in the heavens to mark times and seasons for His purposes (Genesis 1:14). These seasons—summer, winter, seedtime, and harvest—are unchanging and ordained by God to govern the natural order while also symbolizing divine timing and purpose (Genesis 8:22; Psalms 74:17). Ecclesiastes reminds us that there is a divinely appointed season for everything under heaven, underscoring God's control over all times and events (Ecclesiastes 3:1). Jeremiah’s lament that the summer is ended and salvation has not come serves as a sober reminder of the spiritual urgency within these appointed times (Jeremiah 8:20).
